title: Mixed Event — Wonderhorror?! A Test of Courage! — Episode5 Cute and Helpful Ghosts

meta.Event Outline: Class representatives Emu and Mafuyu are assigned to run a voluntary weeding activity. But no one's signing up to pull weeds in the blazing summer heat! Emu thinks of a way to make it fun for the participants.

rows.Line: A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Asahinaaa!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Is it true that more people have signed up to pull weeds with us?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I was also surprised when the teacher told me the news. It seems that ten people have signed up just today.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whaaat?! Ten people?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They apparently all decided to sign up after seeing the posters and flyers you made, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You did a particularly good job with that poster. The way you had “Pulling Weeds!” and “Test of Courage!” written next to each other made it very easy to understand what this event involves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It sparked interest among my classmates. They were all chatting about what it could mean to pull weeds while doing a test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's all thanks to your hard work, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe!
We also have you to thank you for helping!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Hehe.
We should be able to get more than enough people to sign up now.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, I really wasn't expecting to hold a test of courage after the weed-pulling...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: When I heard how spooky people thought the shrine and mountain were, our park's haunted house came to mind.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because it's scary, but it can also be fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, some people don't like being scared, but others really enjoy those kinds of things.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Still, as surprised as I was, it's very like you to find the fun in fear.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Let's do our best together and make our test of courage a really fun one!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, umm... About that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm one of those who don't really enjoy being scared, so I'm not sure how I'll be able to help...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Don't worry!
We're gonna make it a happy smiley test of courage that even those who don't really like horror and stuff can enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A happy smiley test of courage...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I can't say that I have a clear picture of what we're going to do yet, but I'm sure it'll be fun with you in charge, Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks! It will be!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, let's start coming up with ideas for our test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Alright, regarding the program of events for our test of courage, does sticking with what we discussed previously sound good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes! We'll all meet up at the shrine after pulling weeds and take groups off up the mountain one at a time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, how big should each group be...?
Normally, you do these in pairs...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... It isn't always easy for a random pair to strike up a conversation, so how about three per group?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
That sounds good.
They'll be walking along a mountain path in the dark, so more people may be better in this case.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay, three per group...
We also need to decide how often we send groups out...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that will depend on the distance between the shrine and the end of the trail, as well as how we decide to frighten them.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right. Why don't we leave measuring out the length of the trail for a later date, and today we can focus on how we're going to scare them?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I have an idea!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I wanna dress up like a monster plushie that jumps out at everyone, but isn't too scary!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A monster plushie?
Yes, that wouldn't be all that frightening.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: In that case, let's come up with some designs for your monster costume today. Then, on the weekend...
Holiday
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhummｍ♪
Monster, monster, monster costume shopping♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We came up with quite a few costume designs during our brainstorming session.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
We did.
Unfortunately, I don't think we'll be able to make all of them with just three of us, so we'll need to narrow them down.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But for now, we should head over to the handicrafts shop in the mall and—
Huh? Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, I thought it was you!
And you've got Honami and Emu with you!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Mizuki? Hinomori?
What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh. Shizuku and I just spent some time hanging out together at the sewing lounge!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Were you three about to head somewhere?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yes!
We're gonna go buy stuff for our test of courage!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Test of courage?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're recruiting volunteers to pull weeds with us, but had to come up with a way to make things more fun for everyone...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Which is why you're having a test of courage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We were just about to go buy stuff to make a cute monster costume!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? A cute monster?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We'll be working with some of the locals in the area, so we decided to make as cute a monster as possible to ensure that people who don't like being scared can also have fun.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool...!
That does sound like fun!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, can I join in?
I can probably give you three a hand with your costume since I'm pretty good at making those kinds of things!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I can make one that's all pink and frilly!
Or a monster with cat ears! The possibilities are endless!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
What...?!
You'd help us?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Also, I can probably pull weeds and do your test of courage as long as I find someone to cover for me at work.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, wait a second...
Is it okay for a student from another school to participate?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That should be fine since we're already recruiting local residents. Still, are you sure...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, of course!
After going to the sewing lounge, I really feel like making some more stuff! Plus, this sounds like a really fun opportunity♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I agree.
In that case, I'd like to help out as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let me check to see if I'm free that day to pull weeds.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Wait, Hinomori, you too...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But aren't you busy with work...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're in a bit of a lull period at the moment, so I should be able to at least help with your monster costume.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
I really appreciate you offering to help like this.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay.
Also, Asahina may already know this...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I happen to have something that you may be able to use during your test of courage♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something we can use during our test of courage...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
It does seem perfect for this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, don't leave us in the dark!
What are you two talking about?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll bring it over when we make our monster costumes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, do you have to leave me hanging like that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, Shizuku and I wanna help.
What do you say? Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yes, thank you both very much!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Hehe. I'm looking forward to working with you all on this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, let's go grab what we need!
I know a great handicrafts shop that sells cute fabrics and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Then, let's go go go!
